title: marsdenia volubilis var. angustifolia
intro: Marsdenia volubilis var. angustifolia, commonly known as the "Snake Flower" or "Marsdenia", is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsdenia volubilis var. angustifolia include acting as an expectorant and antispasmodic, which helps to relieve coughs and respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as marsdenine and nor-marsdenine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
